wiki.title: Rich McCormick
wiki.extract: Richard Dean McCormick (born October 7, 1968) is an American physician and politician. A member of the Republican Party, he has represented Georgia in the United States House of Representatives since 2023. Until 2025, he represented the 6th congressional district. In 2024, he was elected to represent the 7th congressional district.
